semiconductor_relevance: High — Shibuya Corporation specializes in advanced equipment for semiconductor assembly and packaging, particularly in laser bonding technologies.
summary: Shibuya Corporation is a leading provider of laser flip chip bonding and micro ball mounting equipment for the semiconductor industry. They focus on innovative solutions such as Laser-Assisted Thermo-Compression Bonding (LATCB) and fluxless soldering technologies that enhance the efficiency and cleanliness of semiconductor packaging processes.
capabilities: Fluxless soldering using plasma and forming gas
